title: Can Synthetic Data be Fair and Private? A Comparative Study of Synthetic Data Generation and Fairness Algorithms

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating predictive models trained on synthetic and real data using fairness metrics (ABROCA, Error Rate Difference, and True Positive Rate Difference) with 'sex' as the sensitive attribute in a student math performance dataset.

Evaluating predictive models trained on synthetic and real data using fairness metrics (ABROCA, Error Rate Difference, and True Positive Rate Difference) with 'disability' as the sensitive attribute in a university learning analytics dataset.

Evaluating predictive models trained on synthetic and real data using fairness metrics (ABROCA, Error Rate Difference, and True Positive Rate Difference) with 'race' as the sensitive attribute in a law school bar passage dataset.
